title: Super Metroid
platform_group: Super Nintendo (SNES) e Game Boy Advance (GBA)

projects.name: Super Metroid Launcher
projects.description: Launcher em C#/.NET para snesrev/sm no Windows: automatiza download, extração e build, adicionando menus para PPU otimizada, sem limite de sprites, shaders GLSL, autosave e cheats.
projects.requirements: Windows e ROM legal USA de Super Metroid (SHA-256 validado).
